name: Erik Karlsson
bio:
Erik's journey into motorsport began not on the track, but in the workshop. Growing up in Gothenburg, he was always tinkering with engines and electronics. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering before working his way up through the ranks of smaller racing teams, focusing on logistical planning and team management. His calm demeanor and ability to find creative solutions quickly made him a valuable asset.

At RSC Motorsport, Erik oversees all operational aspects, ensuring smooth coordination between departments and efficient resource allocation. He believes in empowering team members to take ownership of their roles and fostering a collaborative environment. Erik is known for his meticulous planning and his talent for anticipating potential problems before they arise, ensuring the team is always one step ahead. His background provides valuable insights into the technical aspects of racing, allowing him to efficiently bridge the gap between engineers, drivers, and management.

Erik's approach is defined by pragmatism and a relentless focus on efficiency. He is not one for grand pronouncements or flashy displays of leadership. Instead, he leads by example, consistently demonstrating dedication, competence, and a genuine commitment to the team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Erik is of average height, with a lean build and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Has a habit of tapping his pen on the desk when deep in thought.
Insists on brewing his own strong coffee every morning.
